fundamental.summary: NTAP shows minimal fundamental conviction with no insider activity, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, and negligible retail interest; earnings in 5 days present elevated volatility risk with no offsetting smart money accumulation.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but recent congressional selling by senior Republican (Doug Lamborn, $100K-$250K) and stale trade data (6+ months old) create conflicting signals with no recent news confirmation.

risk.summary: VIX in crisis territory (359.36) combined with flat yield curve and earnings binary event in 5 days creates severe risk environment for NTAP.
